guard: stock cotal supervise validates retained authority at resume and commit, then refuses hosted terminal retirement before requester issuance while the alias remains held
command: pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/auth build && pnpm --filter @cotal-ai/manager build && COTAL_OWNER_NATIVE_ACCEPTANCE=1 pnpm probe:hosted-retirement-stock-supervise
why: This owner-native acceptance starts the real cotal supervise CLI, an authenticated broker, registry-pinned HTTPS authority, and a retained child from a registry-only participant root.

The release mutation proves the stock callback is the fail-closed boundary before retirement requester issuance; the commit mutation proves the third HTTPS validation is a fresh commit-time check rather than startup traffic.
The admin mutations prove remote serve-time authorization cannot bypass the host callback and cannot ignore the caller lifecycle bound to the host row.

mutations.name: stock activation resends the full command-schema closure
mutations.expectRed: stock cotal supervise reaches manager ready through remote prepare and activate
mutations.cell: stock cotal supervise reaches manager ready through remote prepare and activate

mutations.name: stock supervision silently accepts hosted release without a host composition
mutations.find: throw new Error("remote participant supervision cannot terminally retire a hosted managed agent without a host release composition");
mutations.expectRed: stock hosted deprovision fails closed at the explicit host-release refusal
mutations.cell: stock hosted deprovision fails closed at the explicit host-release refusal

mutations.name: resume commit skips its fresh retained-authority validation
mutations.expectRed: stock resume commit fresh-validates retained authority through registry-pinned HTTPS
mutations.cell: stock resume commit fresh-validates retained authority through registry-pinned HTTPS

mutations.name: remote manager bypasses host-owned admin authorization
mutations.find:
if (this.remoteAuthority)
      return this.remoteAuthority.authorizeAdmin({ owner: caller.owner, actor: caller.actor, lifecycleUid: caller.uid });
mutations.expectRed: narrowed host admin scope refuses before the manager operation runs
mutations.cell: narrowed host admin scope refuses before the manager operation runs

mutations.name: host admin authorization ignores caller lifecycle binding
mutations.expectRed: stale caller lifecycle refuses without a reason oracle or manager operation
mutations.cell: stale caller lifecycle refuses without a reason oracle or manager operation
